title: 统一混合检索索引
outcome: 为Memory、Knowledge、Context、Observation、Progress和Skill建立可重建的SQLite B-tree与FTS5索引，并接入统一search命令
acceptance: 源文件仍是事实源；search rebuild幂等；关键词/BM25/过滤可用；中文可检索；Context按任务召回；生命周期使用统一搜索；测试与文档通过
plan: 审计数据源与CLI；定义索引schema；先写失败测试；实现增量/全量重建；实现混合查询；接入生命周期；文档和端到端验证；推送

events.message: Progress record created before task execution.
Implemented SQLite B-tree metadata indexes, FTS5 multilingual lexical search, optional generation-safe semantic ranking, freshness checks, and atomic concurrent rebuilds.
Integrated unified search into CLI, installer wrappers, lifecycle context recall, configuration, and documentation.
Added regression coverage for source types, Chinese precision, filters, freshness, lifecycle recall, concurrency, validation, and vector generation safety; all 23 tests pass in verified groups.
Implementation and independent standards/spec reviews completed; all material findings fixed.
